(I)--Mt. a hill in भारतवर्ष, near Brin- दावन्,
1: भा. V. १९. १६; X. ११. ३६; १३. २९.
held by कृष्ण for a week warding off rain;
2: X. २५. १९; २७. 1; Vi. V. ११. १६-25; १२. 1; १३. 1 and 4, २८; १५. 1.
sacred to भरद्वाज who brought down heavenly trees and plants on behalf of राम;
3: M. ११४. ३८.
worship of, with prayers and viands; sacrifice of goats to.
4: Vi. V. १०. 8, ३८.

(I)--the name given to कृष्ण by Indra the lord of Gokula;
1: भा. X. २७. २३, २८; Br. III. ३३. 8.
the यादव king; went in search of मणि by tracing the steps of Prasenajit when he was supposed to have killed him for the sake of the jewel, and came upon a place where Prasena and his horses were dead; proceeding he saw a dead lion and further a cave of a bear in the Vindhyas and heard the talk of a muse fondling the son of the bear; overhearing he heard: “dont cry„ Syamantaka is yours”. Then he entered the mouth of the cave and saw जाम्बवान्, the king of bears; had hand-to-hand fight for २१ days; the followers of कृष्ण returned to द्वारवती and spread the news that कृष्ण was dead; defeating the bear he got the hand of his daughter जाम्बवती with the मणि and returned home; gave it to शक्रजित् in an assembly.
2: वा. ९६. ३२-50.
--the residence of the constellations--हस्तम्, चित्र, स्वाति; one in the Madhya मार्ग. Br. III. 3. ५०; M. १२४. ५७; वा. ६६. ४९.
--the overlord of humped animals (quadru- peds). Br. III. 8. ११; वा. ७०. १०.
--the Bull, the riding animal of शिव. वा. ५४. ४५; १०१. २३७, २४६.
